1.title: what building a $3 million/year youtube business actually looks like
1.author: AlexanderTheCreate
1.hook: First-hand breakdown of YouTube creator economics at $3M ARR — likely covers channel metrics, monetization mix (AdSense, sponsorships, products), growth trajectory, and platform algorithm mechanics from a creator building a sustainable business.

2.title: AI Agents Will Be Mandatory in 1 Year | Glenn Solomon
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Glenn Solomon (Notable Capital, early Anthropic investor) on why AI coding agents accelerate rather than replace developers, the IPO timing, and why startups must ship product improvements faster than frontier models advance to avoid obsolescence.

1.title: Anthropic’s IPO Means GPU Prices Will Keep Rising | Modal
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Modal CEO on Anthropic's IPO implications for GPU pricing, Modal's 400x sandbox revenue growth, inference-vs-training demand shift, and which AI applications will break out in the next 12 months.

1.title: Head of Instagram Reveals How the Top 1% Actually Work With AI
1.author: Silicon Valley Girl
1.hook: Adam Mosseri (Head of Instagram) walks through his personal AI stack: email writing with learned voice patterns, meeting briefing systems, shared memory across tools, and decision stress-testing. Also covers Instagram's engagement metrics, what views actually measure, Trial Reels design intent, and creator feedback loops.

2.title: AI Cyberattacks Have Jumped 5x in the Last Year | Wiz
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Wiz researchers discuss training Gemini 4 for autonomous penetration testing, claiming frontier models now outperform human security experts; they correlate a 4-5x surge in cyber incidents to AI-enabled attacks. Speed vs. creativity in exploit generation; defensive implications for companies.

1.title: Variety Content on YouTube - Watch this First!
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube's Head of Content Strategy explains variety content mechanics: finding an anchor point that connects disparate topics, managing audience expectations across experiments, packaging variety into unified formats, and when experimentation crosses into channel damage.
